verses.text: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty. Live in my presence and do what is right in every way.
I will make my covenant between me and you, and I will give you a very large family."
Abram bowed down with his face to the ground, and God said to him,
"This is my covenant with you: you will be the father of many nations.
Your name will no longer be Abram. Your name will be Abraham, because I have made you the father of many nations.
I will give you many, many descendants. Nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants.

I will keep my covenant between me and you and your descendants after you, for all generations to come. It will be a covenant that lasts for ever. I will be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
I will give the whole land of Canaan, where you are now living as a stranger, to you and your descendants after you. It will be theirs for ever, and I will be their God."
Then God said to Abraham, "As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you, for all generations to come.
This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you must keep: every male among you must be circumcised.
You must cut off the foreskin of your bodies. It will be the sign of the covenant between me and you.

For all generations to come, every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised. This includes those born in your household and those bought with money from a foreigner, who are not your own children.
Whether they are born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your bodies will be a covenant that lasts for ever.
Any male who is not circumcised must be cut off from his people, because he has broken my covenant."
God also said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you must no longer call her Sarai. Her name will be Sarah.
I will bless her, and I will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her so that she will be the mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her."
Abraham bowed down with his face to the ground. But he laughed and said to himself, "Can a man who is a hundred years old have a son? Can Sarah have a baby at the age of ninety?"
And Abraham said to God, "If only Ishmael could live under your blessing!"

Then God said, "Yes, but your wife Sarah will have a son, and you will name him Isaac, which means 'he laughs'. I will keep my covenant with him as a covenant that lasts for ever, for his descendants after him.

And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. I will surely bless him. I will give him many children and greatly increase his numbers. He will be the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
But I will keep my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will have by this time next year."
When God had finished speaking with Abraham, he went up from him.
On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and every male in his household, those born in his household and those he had bought, and circumcised them, just as God had told him.
Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
and his son Ishmael was thirteen.
Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that same day.
And every male in Abraham's household, those born there and those bought from foreigners, was circumcised with him.
